name: @tickadoo/mcp-server
description: tickadoo MCP Server — 14 AI-powered tools for discovering and booking 13,090+ experiences across 681 cities. Agent intelligence layer with best picks, price tiers, mood search, city guides, family planners, and booking urgency signals. No API key required.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true });" && ./node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.js
